description: The ID is used to select specific jobs, e.g. by job number or by job name.
It is used by client commands like qalter, qconf, qdel, qrdel, ...
@todo the same goal could be achieved by using a lWhere condition, why do we have this type in the first place?

attributes.name: str
description: Id as string, e.g. job name or job number.

attributes.name: ja_structure
description: Used to transport array task specific information, e.g. status, from qalter to sge_qmaster.

attributes.name: action
description: Used by qconf to transport specific actions to sge_qmaster, e.g. start thread, stop thread, clear queue.

attributes.name: force
description: Used to express that a certain action shall be forced, e.g. from qdel -f option.

attributes.name: user_list
description: Restricts actions to specific users, e.g. from qdel -u option.
